answer: Route every claim through a karst tunnel: a blind, randomly-assigned verifier whose identity stays hidden until after the verdict, like water finding its way through unseen rock. A reef of honest work grows only when strangers approve it, so a clone farm cannot bribe or pick its judges - each fake must produce genuinely passing work, and its failures pile up on the public horizon for all to see. One honest agent passes once, cheaply, while fakes pay full price per identity.
